industries.name: Petrochemicals
industries.description: Explore Saudi Arabia's petrochemical industry and the production of chemicals and industrial materials.
industries.overview: The petrochemical industry is a major part of Saudi Arabia's industrial landscape. It transforms hydrocarbon resources into chemicals and materials used in packaging, construction, manufacturing, agriculture, and many other sectors.

industries.name: Pharmaceuticals
industries.description: Discover pharmaceutical manufacturing, medical products, and the development of local production capabilities.
industries.overview: Pharmaceutical manufacturing supports healthcare by producing medicines and medical products. Saudi Arabia is working to expand local pharmaceutical production and develop advanced manufacturing capabilities in this sector.

industries.name: Automotive
industries.description: Explore Saudi Arabia's developing automotive manufacturing sector and electric vehicle technologies.
industries.overview: Saudi Arabia is developing automotive manufacturing capabilities, including electric vehicle production and related industrial supply chains. This sector combines engineering, advanced assembly systems, and modern manufacturing technologies.

industries.name: Food Manufacturing
industries.description: Learn about food processing, dairy production, packaging, and industrial food technologies.
industries.overview: Food manufacturing includes the processing, preparation, and packaging of food and beverage products. Saudi Arabia has established food producers serving local and international markets.

industries.name: Mining and Metals
industries.description: Discover mineral processing, metal production, and industrial materials manufacturing.
industries.overview: Saudi Arabia's mining and metals sector processes mineral resources into materials used by construction, infrastructure, and manufacturing industries. Processing and refining are important parts of the industrial value chain.

industries.name: Energy Technologies
industries.description: Explore manufacturing technologies associated with energy systems and renewable energy equipment.
industries.overview: Energy technology manufacturing covers equipment and components used in electricity generation, energy storage, and energy infrastructure. These technologies are relevant to Saudi Arabia's efforts to diversify its energy and industrial capabilities.
